remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated open-concept condominium at 85 Riverside Ave, Stamford, CT. This bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit features modern upgrades throughout, including a stylish kitchen with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops with a waterfall edge. The open living and dining area is perfect for entertaining, while large windows and a private balcony offer stunning river views and flood the space with natural light. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, ample closet space, an additional assigned storage room in the basement, and access to an in-ground pool within the complex. Close to shops, dining, and public transportation, this turnkey home is a must-see! "Owner is asking for the highest and best offers by Monday the 5th at Noon."
